english.title: Use on a road a goods vehicle fitted with a speed limiter which failed to comply with regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when fitted with a speed limiter which did not comply with

(A)_[regulation 36B(7)(a) in that it was not sealed]_
(B)_[regulation 36B(7)(b) in that it was not maintained in good and efficient working order]_
(C)_[regulation 36B(8) in that it was not calibrated to a set speed not exceeding 60 mph]_
(D)_[regulation 36B(9) in that it was set at a speed exceeding 85 km/h and the stabilised speed exceeded 90 km/h]_
(E)_[regulation 36B(10) in that it did not comply with Part 1 of the British Standard or the Annexes to Community Directive 92/24]_
(F)_[regulation 36B(11) in that it (not being a speed limiter to which regulation 36b(10) applied) did not comply with the Annexes to Community Directive 92/24]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 36B(6) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Option C applies to vehicles which are the subject of regulation 36b(1) only.
(ii) Option D applies to vehicles which are the subject of regulation 36b(2) only. The requirements were altered with effect from 1.9.96. See regulation 11a for exception.
(iii) Option E applies to a speed limiter:
(a) fitted at any time to vehicles which are the subject of regulation 36b(1) or 36b(3).
(b) fitted before o1.10.94 to vehicles first used before that date which are the subject of regulation 36b(2).
(iv) Option E does not apply if speed limiter complies with an equivalent standard.
(v) Option F applies to a speed limiter fitted after 01.10.94 to vehicles which are the subject of regulation 36b(2).
(vi) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(vii) See also offence wordings: H1342 and H1343.
english.standardstatementoffacts:

(a)_[was not sealed.]_
(b)_[was not maintained in good and efficient working order.]_
(c)_[was not calibrated to a set speed not exceeding 60 mph.]_
